surface: Stock Rupture (Produits & Stock — Mission 1 unified catalog)
executive_summary: Stock surface is healthy post-restore. API GET /api/admin/stock/catalog-overview returns 200 in ~117 ms with 11 categories (45 items total) + 4 extra groups + 6 variation groups = 21 rail buckets. DOM dump confirmed all 21 buckets render with correct counts, search input present, switches (role='switch') rendered as binary EN STOCK toggles. Visual screenshot capture was contaminated by a parallel test-e2e agent (S4 OSS) running concurrently in the SAME shared Playwright Chrome profile (PIDs 45807/16425/95320 visible in ps aux), which kept navigating the SPA away from /admin/stock/rupture every ~3.5 s. This is NOT an app defect — it is parallel-agent-on-shared-browser contention. Mission objectives (11 categories visible, layout integrity, search box, toggle UX shape) were verified via direct API + DOM eval. Q9-S1 sync ΔT toggle measurement BLOCKED by the same contention (session auth got wiped mid-test). Two observations worth tracking.

S6-01-default-mount.note: Screenshot captured the OSS surface (/admin/order-status-screen) because parallel S4 OSS agent navigated to it ~3.5s after we pushed to /admin/stock/rupture. DOM evidence (separate eval call) showed correct page mounted before contamination.

S6-02-rail-categories.note: Rail buckets dumped via document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid^=stock-mgmt-bucket-]'). All 21 expected buckets present.

S6-07-sauce-q9s1.note: Algérienne sauce variation_ids = [11, 32, 154, 169, 184, 281, 291, 301, 311, 321] (10 cross-product attachments). Toggle endpoint /api/admin/menu/availability/variation/toggle exists and is wired. Empirical ΔT measurement attempted but failed because parallel S4 agent triggered 401 mid-call (axios interceptor wiped session). Cache-invalidation code path was verified manually in prior cycles (Q9-S1 measured ΔT ~1s in V1 Polish Final cycle 2026-05-21, referenced in MEMORY).

sync_evidence_q9s1.reason_for_no_direct_measure: Parallel S4 OSS agent kept hijacking the same Chrome user-data-dir, triggering 401 during toggle POST. The toggle endpoint /api/admin/menu/availability/variation/toggle is correctly wired and dispatches Echo events on private-branch.{branchId}. Code path was last empirically validated 2026-05-21 (Wave Polish Final) — measured 0-60s → ~1s.
sync_evidence_q9s1.code_path_observed: POST admin/menu/availability/(toggle|extra/toggle|variation/toggle) → AvailabilityController → Echo broadcast on private-branch.{branchId} for item.availability.toggled / extra.availability.toggled / variation.availability.toggled. Wizard reload path in kiosk listens to these events (see KioskWizardComponent.vue Echo handlers, frozen file).

findings.title: Mission spec says '3-pane' but actual UI is 2-pane (rail + main)
findings.evidence: Component comment block lines 1-26 in StockRuptureDashboardComponent.vue confirms 'ONE page. Left rail = all browsable buckets... Right pane = product cards'. The phrasing 'extras-by-name + variations-by-attribute' in spec is achieved by GROUPING (all 21 rail buckets), not by 3 horizontal panes.
findings.action: Documentation fix in test spec or owner deck — not an app defect.

findings.title: Shared Playwright Chrome profile causes cross-agent contamination during parallel test-e2e runs
findings.evidence: ps aux shows 3 separate playwright-mcp processes (PIDs 45807, 16425, 95320) all sharing user-data-dir /Users/1millnonstop/Library/Caches/ms-playwright/mcp-chrome-9b44929. Result: S4 OSS agent navigations clobbered S6 stock page every ~3.5 s. Empirically captured in __navLog: /admin/stock/rupture → /admin/pos after 3504 ms.
findings.action: Each parallel deep-test agent should spawn an isolated Playwright context with --user-data-dir set per agent (e.g. /tmp/playwright-S6, /tmp/playwright-S4). The 14-agent orchestration plan should explicitly mandate browser-context isolation.
files: orchestration meta-config — no source file change

findings.title: 11 categories + 4 extras + 6 variations rail buckets restored cleanly post-restore
findings.evidence: /api/admin/stock/catalog-overview returns expected canonical Le Cayenne taxonomy: cat-1..cat-11 named exactly as menu V2 (Sandwich Cayenne 5, Galette 2, Sandwich Classique 2, Burgers 2, Tacos 2, Bols Gourmands 8, Frites 2, Suppléments 10, Desserts 3, Boissons 8, Menu enfant 1 = 45 items). Mission claim ('59 items on branch=1') overcounts — actual = 45 catalog items. Possibly 59 was counted including sub-attribute aggregations (45 catalog + 13 sauces + 6 supps non-double-counted etc.) or post-restore IBA backfill metric. Dashboard h4 (Total articles menu) also reads 45.
findings.action: Reconcile owner-facing item count to 45 (catalog SKUs) vs richer attribute count if needed.

visual_reasoning.color_status_badges: Active bucket: bg-slate-900 white text. Inactive: bg-slate-100 slate-600 text. Switch checked: emerald-500 (EN STOCK). Switch unchecked: red rose-500 (RUPTURE) — verified per component template.
visual_reasoning.long_name_truncate: Confirmed line-clamp via UI: 'Suppléments (à composer)' fits without overflow.
visual_reasoning.cross_axis_dedup: Mission asked: cat 'Suppléments' (10 items) vs extra group 'Suppléments (à composer)' (10 deduped names). Confirmed separate rail entries with disjoint semantics — the cat-8 is item-level (10 SKUs in Suppléments category); extra-supplement is the ATTACHMENT-level (10 distinct extra names cross-product). No double-count user confusion in UI.

technical_reasoning.api_bounded_select: Single round-trip 117 ms for 21 buckets + 45 items + ~80 extra attachments + ~140 variation attachments — bulk query optimization correctly applied (Mission 1 acceptance criterion).
technical_reasoning.toggle_endpoints_wired: POST admin/menu/availability/toggle, admin/menu/availability/extra/toggle, admin/menu/availability/variation/toggle all referenced in component (lines 548, 559, 579).
technical_reasoning.echo_events_documented: Component template comment: 'Real-time sync via Echo on private-branch.{branchId} for the 3 availability events; 60s polling fallback for admin (branch_id=0).'

sync_reasoning_q9s1.regression_risk_post_restore: LOW — Echo wiring + endpoints + payload schema unchanged; only DB state was restored which is exactly the data Mission 1 backend reads from
